state:
**Goal `php-oracle-retired`: Stages 6 and 7 are on disk; Stage 8 is in progress.** ADR 0274 (`docs/decisions/0274.md`) is the goal's record.

Stage 7 landed before this session (the three fixes and their tests are in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs`, `arr.rs`, `bigint.rs`; the gap records are gone).

Stage 8's first file set is done: the `php-migration/` topic is dissolved. Eleven rules moved and were rewritten without PHP — `types/` (absent-storage-is-never-a-zero-value, an-element-write-needs-storage-to-write-back-into, a-declared-type-answers-before-the-program-runs, one-type-test), `statements/` (a-body-never-falls-off-its-end, no-return-leaves-a-finally, let-and-is-are-reserved), `classes/` (a-constructor-return-carries-no-value, a-readonly-property-declares-no-default), `expressions/no-partial-application`, `security/a-session-id-the-store-did-not-issue-is-rejected`. `every-divergence-is-deliberate-and-listed` and `a-deprecation-is-a-refusal` are deleted, with every live citation re-pointed and frozen ones stripped of `rule:`. The moved records still carry `divergesFromPhp`; the next group deletes the field everywhere.
